441_record_correction: 441 RECORD CORRECTION: '3D strengthens the NO-GO' was the wrong sign. Every published FULL-3D solar molecular-C abundance (8.39 / 8.47 / 8.52) lands within ~0.10 dex of the 8.46 reference, while the 1D mu=1 value is 8.646 (+0.186). So 3D corrects TOWARD the reference (implied correction ~ -0.13..-0.26 dex), reopening ACE-as-solar-CO-source rather than strengthening the NO-GO. Magnitude is model-generation dependent (Popa 2025); REOPEN is 'viable pending a full-3D-cube synthesis (Linfor3D-class)', not a turnkey clearance. The <3D> mean-model probe is a partial lower bound and here points the wrong way -- the demonstration that the horizontal-inhomogeneity term (which <3D> omits) is essential.
